testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive buttons, input fields, links, modal triggers, tab switchers, and metrics MUST contain unambiguous data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='careers-hero-enquire-btn', data-testid='audience-switcher-usa').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility: WCAG AA contrast compliant text, screen reader friendly labels, keyboard navigable modals.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure Goalfinity Careers is given primary top prominence on the home page hero while Goalfinity Institute is distinctly presented immediately below it.
2. Implement the interactive Audience Switcher toggle at the top of the Home page to instantly personalize highlighted benefits for USA students vs Ahmedabad students.
3. Build multi-page navigation using react-router-dom with distinct routes: '/', '/careers', '/institute', '/about', '/contact', and '/admin'.
4. Highlight the no-price rule explicitly with 'Enquire for fees' buttons and clear fee enquiry forms that submit to local admin inbox state and show email confirmation to Info@goalfinity.co.
5. Use brand colors accurately: Careers = Deep Blue #0B3F9E, Bright Blue #2480F1, Star Yellow #F5A623; Institute = Navy #0F1F5C, Green #1E9A4A.
6. Include floating WhatsApp and Call action buttons across all pages.
7. Include data-testid attributes on ALL buttons, forms, links, and key sections.
8. Note that codebase files use standard .js extension.
